message: We propose a 10-year full-scope agreement covering repairs, engines and rotables, with a hybrid pricing model (50% fixed, 50% tied to actual running hours). Year-1 fee is $7.0M, escalating 3% per year, with 96% availability and a penalty cap of 15% of the annual fee. We are happy to discuss adjustments to fit your operating plan.

Thank you for the proposal. $7.0M is above our approved budget, so we need a lower year-1 fee. We'd also like stronger availability and lease-engine coverage given our downtime exposure. Our counter: $5.0M year 1, hybrid pricing, 2% escalation, 10 years, 97.5% availability, 20% penalty cap, full scope with lease engine included.

We appreciate the counter, but $5.0M with a 2% escalator and a lease engine is not something we can sustain, and 10 years requires at least 2.5% escalation under our policy. We can move meaningfully on the fee: $6.0M year 1, hybrid pricing, 3% escalation, 10 years, 96.5% availability, 15% penalty cap, full scope, no lease engine. This keeps the agreement profitable for both of us.

We can meet you partway on escalation, but $6.0M is still outside our approved budget. Our counter: $5.2M year 1, hybrid pricing, 2.5% escalation (matching your policy floor), 10 years, 96.5% availability, 15% penalty cap, full scope, no lease engine. This keeps the deal clearly profitable for you while fitting our approval limit.

We've moved on escalation to 2.5%, which meets our policy floor. At $5.2M, though, the deal falls below our minimum margin, so we can't accept that fee. Our best position: $5.9M year 1, hybrid pricing, 2.5% escalation, 10 years, 96.5% availability, 15% penalty cap, full scope, no lease engine. That's a meaningful step from our side and is as low as we can go while keeping the agreement sustainable.

$5.9M is still well above what we can justify for this scope and availability. Our counter: $5.6M year 1, hybrid pricing, 2.5% escalation, 10 years, 97.0% availability, 20% penalty cap, full scope, no lease engine. The higher availability guarantee and penalty cap give you a clear performance commitment, and this fee keeps us within approval with a sustainable margin for you.

Our fee can't drop to $5.6M with 97% availability and a 20% penalty cap; that combination puts the deal below our margin floor. We're holding at $6.0M year 1, hybrid pricing, 2.5% escalation, 10 years, 96.5% availability, 15% penalty cap, full scope, no lease engine. This is the lowest fee that keeps the contract compliant, and we're open to other trade-offs on your side if the fee has to come down.
$6.0M is above our approved limit and, on our numbers, it is worse than our alternative. We can't accept it. Thank you for your time; we're ending the negotiation here.
